metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for analytics, Shopify, React, Google Workspace scripting, PDFs, media and MCP servers - with migration notes for plugins that moved to official marketplaces

plugins.name: developer
plugins.description: Development workflow skills: write and execute Product Requirement Plans (PRPs), containerise projects with current Docker practice, and review architecture against the Fifteen-Factor App methodology

plugins.name: documents
plugins.description: Document toolkit: fast PDF text extraction, OCR for scanned PDFs, structured parsing of PDFs and office files, plus uv-runnable scripts for forms, tables, merging, splitting and validation

plugins.name: timezone-tools
plugins.description: [RETIRED] Current Claude models convert timezones reliably on their own. This final version only shows a notice - uninstall it.

plugins.name: shopify-developer
plugins.description: Shopify development reference for Liquid, Online Store 2.0 themes, theme performance, debugging, Hydrogen, apps and Functions. Defers live GraphQL schema lookup and validation to Shopify's official shopify-ai-toolkit plugin and Dev MCP server.

plugins.name: google-apps-script
plugins.description: Comprehensive Google Apps Script development guide covering SpreadsheetApp, DocumentApp, GmailApp, DriveApp, CalendarApp, FormApp, SlidesApp, triggers, and Workspace automation

plugins.name: tampermonkey
plugins.description: Write Tampermonkey userscripts for browser automation, page modification, and web enhancement with comprehensive API reference

plugins.name: google-tagmanager
plugins.description: Google Tag Manager guardrails: the overloaded vocabulary, the mistakes models typically make, the three JavaScript environments and the 2026 optimised container model, with links to Google's docs for the rest. Bundles the Stape GTM MCP server and supports the owntag gtm CLI

plugins.name: google-analytics
plugins.description: Google Analytics 4 guardrails: the overloaded vocabulary, the mistakes models typically make, why numbers differ between reports, the Data API and BigQuery, and Data Manager - with links to Google's docs for the rest. Adds cost-controlled querying of the GA4 BigQuery export, bundles Google's read-only Analytics MCP server and supports the ga CLI for configuration changes

plugins.name: google-ads-scripts
plugins.description: Expert guidance for Google Ads Script development including AdsApp API, campaign management, ad groups, keywords, reporting, and automation

plugins.name: mcp-perplexity
plugins.description: Perplexity AI-powered search and information retrieval

plugins.name: mcp-excalidraw
plugins.description: Hand-drawn diagrams with streaming animations, fullscreen editing, checkpoint/restore, and export to excalidraw.com

plugins.name: mcp-alphavantage
plugins.description: Stock market data, company information, and financial indicators via AlphaVantage

plugins.name: mcp-coingecko
plugins.description: Cryptocurrency prices, market data, and historical trends via CoinGecko

plugins.name: mcp-currency-conversion
plugins.description: Real-time currency exchange rates and conversion (no API key required)

plugins.name: mcp-google-workspace
plugins.description: Gmail, Drive and Calendar through your own Google OAuth client - 38 tools, several of which act as you (send mail, share files, manage events)

plugins.name: mcp-mikrotik
plugins.description: MikroTik router management and network automation

plugins.name: mcp-n8n
plugins.description: n8n workflow automation integration

plugins.name: mcp-open-meteo
plugins.description: Weather and climate data (no API key required)

plugins.name: ffmpeg
plugins.description: FFmpeg CLI reference for video and audio processing, format conversion, encoding, filtering, and media automation

plugins.name: message
plugins.description: Message drafts for Gmail, mail apps, WhatsApp, Slack, X and 17 more destinations, with a live Copy/Open preview

plugins.name: humanise
plugins.description: Humanise text and remove AI writing patterns. Detects and fixes 39 AI tell-tales, from Wikipedia's Signs of AI writing and 2025-26 corpus studies of model tells, including inflated language, promotional tone, AI vocabulary, vague expressions of connection, filler phrases, sycophantic tone, placeholder text, formulaic structure, and thematic breaks.

plugins.name: react-best-practices
plugins.description: Vercel Engineering's React and Next.js performance rules, ranked by impact, with local notes for React Compiler and Next.js 16 caching.

plugins.name: lsp-css
plugins.description: CSS, SCSS, and Less language server via vscode-langservers-extracted - provides diagnostics, completions, hover documentation, and formatting for stylesheets

plugins.name: lsp-html
plugins.description: HTML language server via vscode-langservers-extracted - provides tag and attribute completions, diagnostics, hover documentation, and formatting for HTML files

plugins.name: lsp-json
plugins.description: JSON and JSONC language server via vscode-langservers-extracted - provides schema validation, completions, and formatting for JSON files

plugins.name: lsp-yaml
plugins.description: YAML language server - provides schema validation, completions, hover documentation, and formatting for YAML files. Auto-detects schemas for GitHub Actions, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and more

plugins.name: lsp-bash
plugins.description: Bash and shell script language server - provides ShellCheck-powered diagnostics, completions, hover documentation, and go-to-definition for shell scripts

plugins.name: git-github
plugins.description: Git and GitHub conventions with a live GitHub Actions version check that resolves every uses: line from GitHub, plus a user-triggered /release workflow that bumps every version file, moves the changelog, tags and publishes a GitHub release after confirmation.

plugins.name: model-id-upgrade
plugins.description: Find and upgrade stale Claude model IDs across skills, agents, configs and code after a new Claude release. Read-only ripgrep scan that separates records (logs, changelogs, transcripts) from targets, an approval gate, then ID-only edits.

plugins.name: media-tools
plugins.description: Search YouTube and download captions or audio with yt-dlp, then transcribe audio locally with Whisper (mlx-whisper on Apple Silicon, openai-whisper elsewhere)

plugins.name: typst
plugins.description: Typst language reference: markup, maths, set/show rules, layout, tables, templates and PDF/HTML/PNG/SVG export, current to Typst 0.15

plugins.name: quarto-revealjs
plugins.description: Quarto Reveal.js slide decks: meeting and technical-talk templates, clean light and dark SCSS themes, speaker notes, code highlighting, Mermaid and PDF export
